story.heading: A camera was the beginning.
story.label: Our story
story.body: Charis Creations began in 2013 with a camera and a belief that people deserve to see their lives and work represented with care. Today we photograph weddings, create films, produce brand stories and work with organisations across Uganda. The work has grown. The attention we give people remains at its centre.
story.alt: The Charis Creations team together in the studio, three seated in front and the rest standing behind

faq.heading: A few things you may be wondering.

items.q: How do I reserve my date?
items.a: Your booking fee confirms the booking. For weddings and introductions, your date is reserved once 70% of the package has cleared. Our Terms explain the details.
Yes. For events more than 100 km from our studio in Namugongo, the client provides accommodation for the crew.
You can move your event to a new date within 6 months, if our team is free. Everything you paid moves with you.

items.q: How will we receive our work?
items.a: Your finished photographs and film arrive through a private online gallery link.
One round of revisions is included. Send your requests within 14 days of delivery.

items.q: Can I gift a studio session?
